segments.name: Beverage Packaging, North and Central America
segments.description: Produces and sells aluminum beverage containers to fillers of carbonated soft drinks, beer, energy drinks and other beverages in North and Central America.
segments.evidence: Aluminum beverage containers are primarily sold under multi-year supply contracts to fillers of carbonated soft drinks, beer, energy drinks and other beverages.

segments.name: Beverage Packaging, EMEA
segments.description: Manufactures and sells aluminum beverage containers throughout Europe, Middle East and Africa regions to beverage fillers.
segments.evidence: Our EMEA region operations include 19 facilities throughout Europe and one facility each in Cairo, Egypt, and Manisa, Turkey.

segments.name: Beverage Packaging, South America
segments.description: Produces and sells aluminum beverage containers in South America through facilities in Brazil, Argentina, Chile and Paraguay.
segments.evidence: Our operations consist of 12 facilities—9 in Brazil and one each in Argentina, Chile and Paraguay.

revenueModel.text: Customers are beverage fillers and major multinational beverage companies purchasing aluminum containers under multi-year supply contracts, with aluminum price pass-through provisions.
revenueModel.evidence: Aluminum beverage containers are primarily sold under multi-year supply contracts to fillers of carbonated soft drinks, beer, energy drinks and other beverages.

changes.text: In 2024, the company divested its aerospace business, which was historically presented as a reportable segment, shifting to three beverage packaging segments.
changes.evidence: On February 16, 2024, the company completed the divestiture of its aerospace business. The transaction represents a strategic shift; therefore, the company's consolidated financial statements reflect the aerospace business' financial results as discontinued operations for all periods presented. The aerospace business was historically presented as a reportable segment. Effective as of the first quarter of 2024, the company reports its financial performance in the three reportable segments outline
